verdict.rationale: GitLab's own site claims the platform covers work "from planning to source control to CI/CD", and other evidence shows it holds issues and milestones (the GitHub importer brings them over; agents turn issues into merge requests). That indicates basic work-item tracking, but nothing in the pack documents project boards or roadmaps. Missing for 10: documented project/issue boards, roadmap or epic-level planning views, any link from high-level roadmaps to day-to-day tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of board-based planning.
